title: Generative AI and Perceptual Harms: Who’s Suspected of using LLMs?

bias_targets.methodology: Online experiment presenting participants with fictional freelance profiles, manipulating gender-associated names and AI-generated headshots (men vs. women) to measure differences in participants' suspicion of AI use, quality evaluations of writing samples, and hiring likelihood.

Online experiment presenting participants with fictional freelance profiles, manipulating race-associated names (Black vs. White) and corresponding AI-generated headshots to measure differences in participants' suspicion of AI use, quality evaluations of writing samples, and hiring likelihood.

Online experiment presenting participants with fictional freelance profiles, manipulating names and photos to signal U.S. Nationals (White) versus Foreign Nationals (specifically East Asian identity) to measure differences in participants' suspicion of AI use, quality evaluations of writing samples, and hiring likelihood.
